representation.name: Validate ABO phenotype mapping
representation.shell_command:
mkdir work
tar -xf $(inputs.archive.path) -C work
printf '%s\n' rs41302905 rs8176743 rs1053878 rs2519093 > markers.txt
plink2 --pfile work/match.genotypes.1.1 --extract markers.txt --export A --out target
{
 echo IID INFERRED A_DOSAGE B_DOSAGE O2_DOSAGE
 tail -n +2 target.raw | while read fid iid pat mat sex phen o2_ref b_ref a2_ref a1_ref
 do
   o2=$((2-o2_ref))
   b=$((2-b_ref))
   a2=$((2-a2_ref))
   a=$((a1_ref+a2))
   if [ "$a" -gt 0 ] && [ "$b" -gt 0 ]; then blood=ab
   elif [ "$a" -gt 0 ]; then blood=a
   elif [ "$b" -gt 0 ]; then blood=b
   else blood=o
   fi
   echo "$iid $blood $a $b $o2"
 done
 echo INFERRED_SET
 tail -n +2 target.raw | while read fid iid pat mat sex phen o2_ref b_ref a2_ref a1_ref
 do
   b=$((2-b_ref)); a2=$((2-a2_ref)); a=$((a1_ref+a2))
   if [ "$a" -gt 0 ] && [ "$b" -gt 0 ]; then echo ab
   elif [ "$a" -gt 0 ]; then echo a
   elif [ "$b" -gt 0 ]; then echo b
   else echo o
   fi
 done | sort | tr '\n' ' '
 echo
 echo METADATA_SET
 tail -n +2 work/match.genotypes.1.2.csv | cut -d, -f3 | sort | tr '\n' ' '
 echo
} > validation.txt
